skill: Use NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities for the six months ending June 30, 2022 and June 30, 2021. Positive means the disclosed 2022 value exceeds 2021, negative means below, neutral means equal. Require both literal rows, matching USD unit and six-month periods, and reject conflicts as unavailable. Do not substitute the latest or nearest recent reporting year. Cite both complete raw fact records.

definition.description: Compare disclosed six-month operating cash flow in 2022 with the matching six months in 2021.
